stories.title: Canadá pode se tornar 'membro associado' da União Europeia, diz Von der Leyen

en.title: Canada could become 'associate member' of European Union, says Von der Leyen
en.summary: European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen stated during her annual address to the European Parliament that Canada may obtain associate member status with the European Union.

stories.title: Lotofácil da Independência: bolão de Campinas acerta 15 números e leva R$ 4,4 milhões

en.title: Independence Lotofácil: pool from Campinas hits 15 numbers and wins R$ 4.4 million
en.summary: A lottery pool registered in Campinas, São Paulo won R$ 4.488.579 after matching all 15 numbers in the 2026 Independence Lotofácil draw, one of 72 winning entries for that drawing.

stories.title: Lotofácil da Independência: 2 apostas de Alagoas acertam os números e levam R$ 4,4 milhões

en.title: Independence Lotofácil: 2 bets from Alagoas hit the numbers and win R$ 4.4 million
en.summary: Two lottery entries from Alagoas matched all 15 numbers in the Independence Lotofácil drawing held on Tuesday, each winning R$ 4.488.579.

stories.title: Carlos Andreazza: Dino de Moraes comanda baderna no STF | Estadão Analisa

en.title: Carlos Andreazza: Dino de Moraes commands disorder at STF | Estadão Analyzes
en.summary: An analysis piece discussing Carlos Andreazza's commentary on judicial matters at Brazil's Supreme Federal Court.

stories.title: Chefe da UE diz que Europa lida com mundo 'abertamente hostil' e convida Canadá para ser 1º 'membro associado' do bloco

en.title: EU chief says Europe faces 'openly hostile' world and invites Canada to become first 'associated member' of bloc
en.summary: European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen stated that Europe confronts an openly hostile world and must reconsider its alliances. She invited Canada to become the EU's first associated member status.

stories.title: Resultado da Mega-Sena 3058: 18 apostas do Piauí acertam números; veja valores

en.title: Mega-Sena 3058 result: 18 bets from Piauí match numbers; see amounts
en.summary: Eighteen lottery bets placed in Piauí correctly matched four numbers in Mega-Sena drawing 3058, with winners receiving between R$ 1,185.36 and R$ 7,112.40. No bets matched all six numbers nationally, and the jackpot accumulated to an estimated R$ 102 million for the next drawing.

stories.title: Lotofácil da Independência espalhou 72 prêmios de R$ 4,4 milhões pelo Brasil; confira o rateio

en.title: Lotofácil da Independência distributed 72 prizes of R$ 4.4 million across Brazil; check the distribution
en.summary: The Lotofácil da Independência lottery distributed 72 prizes totaling R$ 4.4 million to winners throughout Brazil.

stories.title: Podcast analisa pedido de vista de Dino e falta de definição sobre Moraes em sessão do STF

en.title: Podcast analyzes Dino's request for review and lack of definition on Moraes in STF session
en.summary: A Supreme Court session regarding a Federal Police report on Minister Alexandre de Moraes was suspended without deciding whether to open an investigation against him, an unprecedented action in the court's history.

stories.title: Três pessoas morrem em acidente com helicóptero de TV em Los Angeles

en.title: Three people die in TV helicopter crash in Los Angeles
en.summary: A television station helicopter covering a traffic accident crashed over a Los Angeles neighborhood on Tuesday, killing at least three people according to firefighters.

stories.title: Helicóptero da NBC News cai e mata três pessoas em Los Angeles; veja vídeo

en.title: NBC News helicopter crashes and kills three people in Los Angeles; see video
en.summary: A helicopter crashed in Los Angeles, resulting in three fatalities.

stories.title: Veja os memes da eliminação do São Paulo para o Boca Juniors na Sul-Americana

en.title: See the memes from São Paulo's elimination against Boca Juniors in the Copa Sudamericana
en.summary: São Paulo was eliminated by Boca Juniors in the Copa Sudamericana, generating various memes on social media.

stories.title: UE abre portas para que Canadá se torne seu primeiro membro associado, afirma von der Leyen

en.title: EU opens doors for Canada to become its first associate member, von der Leyen says
en.summary: European Commission President von der Leyen indicated that Canada could become the European Union's first associate member.

stories.title: Na conta da WHG para o pós-eleição, Selic pode cair a 10%

en.title: In WHG's post-election account, Selic could fall to 10%
en.summary: If the opposition wins the October presidential election and implements public spending cuts of approximately 1.5% of GDP, Brazil's central bank could reduce the Selic rate to 10% next year.

stories.title: Tecban Manager oferece três formatos de gestão para redes de autoatendimento bancário

en.title: Tecban Manager offers three management formats for banking ATM networks
en.summary: Tecban presented its new modular platform for managing banking ATM networks at Febraban Tech 2026, configurable to meet individual financial institutions' needs. The platform was demonstrated alongside discussions on cash management, logistics, and the role of physical money alongside digital payment methods.

stories.title: Desabamento de mina de ouro no Sudão deixa mais de 60 mortos

en.title: Gold mine collapse in Sudan kills more than 60
en.summary: A gold mine collapse in Sudan's Western Kordofan state on Sunday killed at least 60 people. Sudan is among Africa's largest gold producers, though most gold is extracted through dangerous artisanal mining techniques and subsequently smuggled out of the country.

stories.title: UE revela plano para restringir acesso de crianças a redes sociais

en.title: EU reveals plan to restrict children's access to social media
en.summary: European Union authorities announced plans to prevent children under 13 from accessing social media platforms and to restrict online activities for teenagers. The measures aim to enhance child protection in the digital environment.

stories.title: UE criará aliança de seguros climáticos para eventos extremos

en.title: EU will create climate insurance alliance for extreme events
en.summary: The European Union announced the creation of a climate insurance alliance to increase coverage against extreme weather events. The initiative comes as Europe experiences summer drought, wildfires, and heat waves.
